notes.title: Version 1.0 and Future Updates!
notes.content:
[b]Hello dear friends,[/b] ❤️

Today, I have such wonderful news to share with you that I don't even know where to start! 🥳 I've been pouring my heart and soul into [b]Factory Outlet Simulator[/b] for a long time, and thanks to your valuable feedback and endless support, we've taken the game to a whole new level. The game now operates with full automation, the economy system has reached a perfect balance, and our game world has become even more vibrant.

Seeing this big step as a milestone, I'm incredibly proud and delighted to announce that we are now calling our game [b]Version 1.0[/b]. This is just the beginning, and I believe we'll achieve many more successes together.

[b]What's new in this version:[/b]

[b]Great News![/b] 🎉 You can now choose which rack products are placed on during production and in the MachiStart application! By default, the warehouse rack will be selected, but if you wish, our factory restockers can place boxes on the store storage rack. This gives you complete control over logistics management.

[b]3 new factory restockers have been added.[/b] As your business grows, your operations will run smoothly. Bigger orders, faster deliveries!

[b]3 new store restockers have been added.[/b] While customers rapidly consume your products, we won't let your shelves stay empty. Your employees are always on duty!

[b]Significant increase in store profitability.[/b] 💰 Now, selling in the store can earn you more than wholesale. Of course, if you land a good contract, wholesale can also be quick and profitable. The strategy is entirely in your hands!

[b]Modern-looking new racks have been added.[/b] Seeing the same racks constantly had become a bit boring for all of us. You can make your store more attractive with new designs. And please, share your suggestions for more designs with me! (I'm not a carpenter, so I'd love to benefit from your imagination. 🙈)

[b]New wallpapers and floorings have been added.[/b] You can now personalize your spaces even more. 🎨

[b]Adjusted the nonsensical pricing in the customization section.[/b] Finally, you don't have to pay $75,000 for flooring! Enjoy decorating with fair and reasonable prices.

[b]------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]Moving Forward![/b]

Let's take a look at what we've achieved together during the early access period. We continued to enrich our game with your feedback, and here are the other fantastic features we added during this process:

[b]Store Restocker added![/b] 🛍️ Now, our employees place items on the shelves for us. You can sit back and watch your store grow.

[b]Security Guards are on duty![/b] 🚨 Catching customers who steal is no longer our job. Our security team is always vigilant to keep your store safe.

[b]Labeling System added.[/b] You can manage the shelves as you wish and display your products in a more organized way. Control is entirely in your hands! 🏷️

[b]Statistics Screen is now available.[/b] 📊 You can monitor your income and expenses live from the TV screen inside the factory. Financial management has never been easier.

[b]Automation Engineer and MachiStart Application added.[/b] 🤖 You can produce the products you want with a single button without having to visit each machine individually. Save your time!

[b]A Very Large Capacity Truck has been added to the game.[/b] 🚚 The cities might be a bit narrow, but this doesn't prevent us from preparing for intercity journeys. Big vehicles await you for your big plans.

[b]Automatic Sales Points are now at your service.[/b] 🛒 You can load your wholesale sales onto the target vehicle with a single button. Logistics management has never been this practical.

[b]Automatic Loading Option for the Van added.[/b] You can manage your stock and won't have to carry boxes to the van one by one. Less work, more efficiency! 🚛

[b]Rest and Break Room Option for Our Employees added.[/b] ☕ Now, your tired employees can recover by drinking coffee or watching TV. Happy employees mean a successful business!

[b]Train Station added.[/b] 🚂 You can now make your wholesale sales not only by road but also by rail. Time to set sail for new horizons!

[b]In addition,[/b] we've made numerous major and minor bug fixes and optimization updates. We brought the game economy balance to the best state with your feedback. Your gaming experience will now be much smoother and more enjoyable.

[b]------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]Looking Ahead[/b]

With this version, I will continue to develop our game at full speed, aiming to provide you with the best experience. My future plans include:

[b]Adding new side jobs and social environments.[/b]

[b]Creating a more lively city[/b], making the game world more dynamic.

[b]Developing a completely renewed art system[/b] for optimization.

[b]Adding major features like truck journeys to different cities.[/b]

But most importantly, [b]your creative and valuable ideas[/b] mean everything to me! 💡❤️ Together, we can make our game even more perfect with your suggestions.

[b]Final Thanks[/b]

I sincerely thank you for the support you've given so far. We will always move forward to the best together, and being with you on this journey is a great honor for me. [b]I love you all![/b] ❤️

[b]With endless love and thanks[/b] ❤️

notes.title: Store Profit Growth
notes.content:
Hellooo everyone, <3

First of all, I apologize for not uploading updates for a while. As you know, I am the only developer and I had hardly any rest for 2 months. I got a bit sick and I needed some rest to recover. Thank you for your understanding. 

Of course, during this time I continued optimization work, but in order not to keep you waiting any longer, I prepared the increase in store prices that you specifically mentioned in your recommendations. 

Profitable wholesale contracts remained at the same balance. But now the store maximum prices have been significantly increased. Especially for advanced licenses, sometimes the store will be more profitable than wholesale, and sometimes wholesale will be more profitable than the store. 

Some bugs have also been fixed. The car parking lot on the side has been made more beautiful. And optimization improvements have been made. Since I didn't limit the progression of the game or add an endgame, optimization issues can occur for players who progress too far. I am making a system change for this, thank you for your understanding. 

Keep improving the game together <3

notes.title: WHOLESALE BY TRAIN
notes.content:
Helloo everyone, <3

I'd like to announce that I've added one of the things I've said before and planned to add to the game. 

We now have a train station option for wholesale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/1edc695c9eec4ac02c5f7b1b0a792fb3a1a56dfd.png[/img]

We have a small train station on the back side of the city. (On the way to the port road, take the first left turn and it's right opposite :) )

In the next update we will be able to wholesale our design products. I plan to lower the wholesale profit margins a little bit and increase the store revenue a little bit more. I'd be interested in your thoughts on this. 

Thank you for the bugs you reported. Bugs such as the cursor disappearing while on the computer screen, Restocker getting stuck have been fixed. I have also fixed many minor bugs and made a moderate optimization improvement. 

Thank you very much for your support and all your positive and negative criticism. I continue to do my best for you <3

notes.title: Factory Outlet Simulator - Patch version 0.10.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, <3

I've prepared many of the items I shared in the devlog and I'm uploading a patch over the weekend to improve your gaming experience. 

This patch includes:
-Instore product sale prices have been increased.
-Stock Exchange can now drop share values to 0. If it drops to 0, you can lose your entire portfolio :)
-Store Restockers can now place the boxes they are going to return back on the shelf they picked them up from.
-Store Restockers now have more intuitive behavior. They are more oriented to different shelves. 
-There was a lack of feedback in the Auto Sale Zone. It was reinforced with voice and text.
-Forklift reset option added (same button as Car reset)
-Fixed shoe texture bug on shelves.
-Fixed Level text growth issue.
-Smart watch prices were not showing on the shelves. Fixed.
-Storage Racks have been visually improved.

Npc stuck problem will be fixed in the next update. I found the source of the problem but I couldn't include it in this update because it will take a little longer to fix it. I postponed it to the next update in order not to keep it waiting in that process. (you can send me screenshots related to this issue via discord)

In addition, if anyone has experienced the bug of missing a product after each delivery while placing products in the vehicle with autoload, can you tell me the more detailed scenario over discord? 

Thank you very much for your support and understanding. Good games, have fun! <3

notes.title: DEVLOG #22
notes.content:
Greetings to everyone, <3 

Thank you very much for your support. So far, we have added many innovations to the game according to your requests and changed many things according to your requests. 

Some of the updates you liked and some of them, naturally, you didn't like. I accept all your criticisms about the updates that were not liked. I am sorry that I missed some bugs and some details that broke the economy of the game in this process.

I will make bug fixes and changes in the game economy for a few days. I will share some of them with you;

-I realize that it is very annoying when the forklift is stuck and I will make it reset. Although the forklift is useless after the updates, you will be able to automatically place the pallet on the forklift.

-Factory Restocker and Store Restocker stuck bug will be fixed

-I'll fix this, some of the shoes look bad on the labels.

-Sometimes our Factory Restockers don't pick up the box and put it down. This will be fixed.

-I realize you can make money forever if you buy the stock option when it drops to $8. I originally left this as a backdoor, but now stock option values can drop to 0 and you can lose all slots when it drops to 0.

-I think that's the part you'll like the most: Store revenues will increase significantly. :) 

-Store restockers will return a box to the last place they picked it up if they are going to put it back on the shelf. 

-Customer stuck bug in some conditions will be fixed.

-There is a lack of feedback in the Sales area in wholesale. This will be fixed. 

-Level text sometimes gets too big. This will be fixed. 

-Bugs in the auto load section will be fixed.

Many minor and major bugs like these will be fixed. 

In addition to these, can you share with me the situations you want me to fix? 

Thank you very much for your support and understanding. We are developing the game together <3

notes.title: Factory Outlet Simulator - Patch version 0.10.1

Thank you for your feedback, now the fatigue level is progressing more slowly. 

I am ready to listen to your feedback to make it better :)

notes.title: BREAK ROOM FOR EMPLOYEES
notes.content:
Helloooo everyone, <3

I'm here with a new mechanic. 

Now restockers are getting tired. (I received such a request from many people and I wanted to add it because it would feel more realistic.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/72edee7c24f11310a5440e62bcf8831edeeb7115.png[/img]

Of course, I didn't want to do it in a way that would make you work, I don't want to bother you with shift selection every time. Instead, the tired worker goes to the waiting position and rests.  But this is a bit slow. :(  

I'm sharing the best part of this part, now you can design a break room for your tired workers. Tired workers can drink coffee, water, soft drinks, sit and rest for a while, or even watch TV. If you have these products you can quickly increase energy regeneration :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/980808083571cac878313a013056920f12594366.png[/img]

And you don't have to manage it. You just design the room and as soon as an employee feels tired, they can go and fulfill one of these options and recharge their energy very quickly. :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/8304b93442639959dd86b31e46c2835e9ab1b7b7.png[/img]

I am waiting for your comments and bug reports about this part. (As a community, I want you to give feedback such as their energy runs out fast or their rest times are short. Because we are developing the game together. :)

Helloo everyone <3

as I mentioned in the previous update note, I had to spend some time on optimization. optimization is never finished and I decided to upload a patch as part 1 optimization. 

The content of this patch:

-Optimization
-Bug fix
-economy design changes

In a few days I have some surprises for you and I will prepare them and upload another part of optimization updates. 

According to my tests, on some computers it is more efficient to turn off the shadow settings and use the number of lights more optimally.  

Keep the feedback and bug reports coming. We are improving the game together :)

notes.title: AUTO LOADING TO VEHICLES
notes.content:
Helloooo everyone, <3

I continue to prepare each and every one of the things I promised. 

Actually I was preparing loader worker for pickup trucks but I wanted to make a change and coded the system from the beginning and decided that it is more understandable with such a UI. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/a0741e8f81f96978fb905cf6e221c018f1eab854.png[/img]

When we click on the auto load sign we will be able to see the number of boxes in the "Storage Rack" products and we will be able to observe the number of vehicle stocks. 

If we press and hold the hold & place button, it will directly place those boxes on the pickup truck bed. Thus, you will be in control and you will not get tired. Of course, as with everything, for a certain price. :(( :))

Thank you very much for your support for the game. I read the discussions and comments. <3

I share this as a big update because we can say that the full automation part of many updates that we have uploaded for 1 month has been completed.  :)

I am aware that you have a lot of object-based optimization problems regardless of the updates. The next update will be a big optimization update (and maybe we will build some logic into the forklift as an extra... :( ) . And we will continue the mechanics from where we left off. :)

We are developing the game together. Love you all <3

If you have an active order, when you bring your vehicle to the area in the image, if the vehicle contains the box of that product, an information box will appear and it will automatically load all the boxes in the vehicle.

notes.title: DEVLOG #19
notes.content:
[b]Hellooo everyone,[/b]

Thank you very much for the support you have given me so far. I would like to thank each and every one of you for your support since the release of our Prologue version and for embracing our game. 

I have been honest with you and tried to share everything I have prepared with you. 

Today I actually want to share a meaningful devlog for the last time before Release. 

We are 10 days away from the release date. If you haven't added it to your wishlist, don't forget to add it to your wishlist. 

And if you haven't joined our discord server yet, join us and let's chat on Discord :)

[url=https://discord.gg/xwcFRx8ypv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/4a2a669711198f2a3debb57e6ef31b65415e01dc.png[/img][/url]

And I want to collect most of the features added to the game in our early access version in this devlog. 

So let your developer start the pre-release devlog. I love you guys very much. 

[b]NEW FEATURES ADDED TO THE GAME FOR THE EARLY ACCESS VERSION[/b]

[b]Stock Exchange App[/b]
In this stock market application, we will be able to buy shares of rival companies and sell them when they are valued. Thus, we will be able to create additional income for ourselves. There will be a news section about other companies and we will be able to make predictions accordingly. Be careful, if the share value drops to 0, we can lose all our money :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/9ab4142bdd53781e075196a05009ef3525119c84.png[/img]

[b]Machine Breakdown and Repair Mechanics[/b]
Our machines will break down depending on our level. And we will need to repair them. (Don't worry, it's really a very small sequence, I don't want to tire you out)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/a2bd0d948c20fdc6f9292511a6f4cd39671a5d4b.gif[/img]

[b]Forklift and Pallet[/b]
If we have multiple stocks, we can now place them on the pallet to be able to transport them. And with the forklift we can move them around the factory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/e8e33962dc2fc444e807919cceb7244fdd8d5570.gif[/img]

[b]Mechanic and Factory Worker[/b]
The mechanic will fix the machines for us. The factory worker will take the newly produced products from the machines and place them on pallets or storage racks if we have them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/aca915f7a0b1a6818f9cd150eb1485c176f99d28.gif[/img]

[b]Customer Comments[/b]
Customers will now comment on what we do and how we do it. They may be uncomfortable with the price or they may be uncomfortable with the lack of a dressing room. Sometimes they may even comment on the decoration in an annoying way :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/a29de57e686cdeda6aceb94779f0860ffa8bd7b3.png[/img]

[b]Wholesale from the Airport[/b]
We will no longer send our products all over the world only by freighter. Orders for delivery by plane will also come. We will have an extra delivery time. If we don't meet the deadline, our profits will be halved. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/95af6d8712aff13ec0e861bd53f0e3a7eccd969b.png[/img]

[b]Outlet Sign[/b]
Everywhere in the world there are huge signs at the entrance of outlet stores and there are brand advertisements there. We will be able to select the brands we want to stand out on this huge signboard and increase our advertising capacity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/e0538196ed716b0ee6d3e58013551d050c3e6bc8.png[/img]

[b]Cashier[/b]
Many people can't keep up with other work after a while because they are busy with the money in the cash register. We will be able to hire cashiers for this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/f96d9d78fba347eabf17457344b7da1e19de8a76.png[/img]

[b]Credit card[/b]
We kept up with the modern world and added the credit card option to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/48b173cbafd1e98a1ab1019cef625cf268486101.png[/img]

[b]Loan system[/b]
We can run out of cash at critical points in the game and we added a loan system. Don't worry, it won't tire you out, it will just support you in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/b9c47c0d505c7765701bcd4b39c2e26edb4916d5.png[/img]

[b]Theft, Security Gates and CCTV[/b]
Now some customers will secretly steal a product and try to escape, and we can catch them and get our money back. On the factory side, when we are busy, we can follow them through a security camera. Or we can put a security gate on the door and activate the alarm system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/36c53ea9375194b7cbcdcaf1cc2cf05da19f2bfd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/96b451ec5f8d8520fc47eb57b794f489e42fd304.png[/img]

[b]Panel Van (Bigger Truck) & Automatic Placement[/b]
We no longer have to deal with placing our products in the truck one by one. We will be able to place them automatically like wholesale. And as an extra we will be able to buy a bigger Panel Van vehicle :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/d1fe4d1ec34e281105d77ff13de9b065a2d073b4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/8c2a2859f78229fdbe11e85d66b9ac32a7cb1d7d.gif[/img]

[b]New Designable Products[/b]
We will now be able to design and sell Perfume, Bags, Gaming headsets, Hats and Smartwatch in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/a19a5abea1a0ee7c7118b26ee4b268d0fa087d84.png[/img]

[b]New Entrance Signage System[/b]
I realize that the old system looked very bad and I changed it completely. 3D header and signage were added. As an extra we will be able to change the spotlight color. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/5d0e8827b03a65135813bfbb1efddbc00d03c6ef.png[/img]

[b]Store Customization[/b]
We will now be able to completely change the floor and walls of our store. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/a7125c0f1f7ac0cf634d6828e32eb97aee1386d6.gif[/img]

[b]Extra new Features[/b]
-Ability to give customers more or less money
-Vehicle mechanics completely changed.
-Character controller completely changed.
-Customer coins have become more realistic.
-We will be able to add input when buying raw materials.
-Fixed black screen issue in low quality.
-Store ceiling was too low. It is now more realistic.
-production cost has been removed (raw materials are more expensive)
-background music added.
-purchased items can be resold.
-The in-car camera has been made animated. 
-Car camera fixed. 
-New shelves and items added
-Discount cancel option added.
-New raw materials added.
-Level unlock system added.
-Day cycle speed has become changeable. 
-Localization has been improved. (I am very grateful to all our friends who helped).
-Steam Cloud integration
-Steam Stats
-Steam Achievements

And too many bug fixes and improvements to count...

I hope you like the new version of the game. And with your support, we can make Factory Outlet Simulator even better.

It will be released on [b]July 15th[/b]. And we will continue to improve it together <3

notes.title: DEVLOG #18
notes.content:
Greetings to everybody!  <3

We are very close to our release date and your developer is very excited! I'm doing my best to make our early access release almost as good as a full release, and I hope it will be worth the wait! :

I'm continuing level design, bug fixing, economy balancing, and I've added store customization. The theme is something many of our players like, but everyone's style is different.

Tell me what your style is! Do you prefer a luxury store? Or do you prefer an underground store? 

I hope you will like it. Your developer loves you and keeps on working! <3

notes.title: DEVLOG #17
notes.content:
Helloooo everyone,

Today I improved the customization options for our store and factory signage. And I know the image in the prologue version was very annoying. The color tones and look felt very cheap. 

Now we can adjust the font size to our liking. There will be many new features like light color, light brightness, outer frame color, inner background color, text color. 

I need your advice for this customization screen, which camera angle do you think is more beautiful? Or if there is an angle you think would be better, you can recommend :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/5d0e8827b03a65135813bfbb1efddbc00d03c6ef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/81431899d1137a082a3ffb415c2dce057c254307.png[/img]

In addition to these;
-Now we will be able to give customers more or less money. 
-I turned off the interaction with other objects while interacting with the cash register.
-I seriously improved the vehicle mechanics. 
-Player movement has been significantly improved and there is no more unnecessary flying and most importantly, it's not nauseating (I did it from scratch)
-Customers are paying more realistic prices.
- When buying raw materials, we don't increase them by clicking on the button one by one, in addition, I added keyboard input there.
-I activated driver support in low quality settings (computer wouldn't turn on, I apologize).
-The store ceiling was too low. We received a lot of feedback on this and now we have a more spacious environment.
-Cost of production is gone (but the game is more difficult now)
-I'm continuing many bug fixes and improvements like these. Level design will be a lot of fun. :)

notes.content:
Helloooo everyone  👋 

Factory Outlet Simulator launches in early access on July 15th! 🎉 

Features that will be added to our game during this period:

-Surprise new products (it will be a real surprise!)
-Stock exchange app (you will have a lot of fun!)
-Theft and security camera (protecting your factory is a must...)
-Employees (they will make your job much easier...)
-Airport for wholesale (transportation to the whole world is now faster!)
-Trucks (we know you need a bigger truck..)

-Forklift - Machine repair - Credit cards - Invoice (essential when running a factory!)

And we are very excited to meet you with many more planned innovations! 🚀 
Let us know what features you want us to add and any feedback! 🙌
